There are no downloads, no installs and no new hardware. This new low-friction way of playing games is powered by the latest developments in web technologies such as WebAssembly and WebGPU, allowing us to render high-quality game experiences on your device. This is not a game streaming service; this is the power of the New Web. For developers, we’re the official, licensed channel for proper games on the web. We offer self-serve D2C tools to publish, operate and grow their games, with social play, identity and a unique end-to-end business analytics suite built in. Joining Entity at this stage is a rare opportunity to help shape our company and our mission. We are an AI-native business; embracing the latest technologies and tools is essential to being successful with us. About the role We're hiring a Product Manager to own the platform itself. You'll work inside the development team, not at a distance from it. We don't write a spec and throw it over the fence. We want someone who works through problems directly with engineers and designers, makes decisions quickly, and keeps everyone clear on the goal. We're a small team with a launch window ahead of us, so we need to move fast and iterate. The right person knows how much process and documentation is enough to keep everyone aligned, and no more. You'll also be close to how games and players are changing, and keen to build for where the industry is heading. Key responsibilities • Roadmap and releases. Define the core player-facing features, with core and mid-core players at the centre: • Finding (Discovery), launching and playing games, quickly • social features incl voice, spectate, virality • accounts, profiles, billing and the core systems needed to run a consumer platform at scale • cloud saves, trials, drm and the many other games specific features • The playing experience across devices (Incl mobile web) • Developer and publisher tools. Help define the tool suite that our game developers and publishers use to publish, manage and understand their games. We are a D2C self publishing and distribution platform unlocking the web as a channel. • Governance and compliance. Own the platform requirements for: • age verification and ratings • GDPR and privacy • accessibility • security • payment provider rules • Payments infrastructure. Own billing and payments as a platform capability. The Live PM defines the pricing, offers and store experience that run on it. • Technical health.
